facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: injury during routine operation on SG-4100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on SG-4100 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically working live under a documented justification. SG-4100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 12 April 2012 an incident occurred on SG-4100 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during routine operation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
